title: Integer Scale: A Free Lunch for Faster Fine-grained Quantization of LLMs
selection_reason: The abstract introduces calibration-free post-training quantization support for fine-grained LLM quantization, reporting up to 1.85× speedup and larger end-to-end gains on Mixtral and Llama-3 with comparable accuracy. This targets inference quantization overhead and latency.
